incidents.name: Xn00d ERC-777 reentrancy
incidents.notes: The Xn00d SushiBar-style staking contract accepted the ERC-777 n00d token and pulled it with transferFrom before minting shares, so the attacker's ERC-1820 tokensToSend hook re-entered enter() and minted shares against the same deposit repeatedly.

sources.ref: onchain review: Xn00d 0x3561081260186E69369E6C32F280836554292E08 created 2022-09-26T06:42:23Z by 0xee6209bd47c3d58eeba1f25437b76989074f0d19, unrelated to the attack sender; no EIP-1967 events, age from deployment (29.4 days). Loss read from the tx receipt: 20.8215 WETH unwrapped by the attack contract; 20.8215 x $1,411.70 at incidentTimestamp 1666716419 (DefiLlama) = $29,394.
